newsitem.title: FRANCE: Remy says H2 begun with good activity.
newsitem.headline: Remy says H2 begun with good activity.

text.p: French drinks group Remy-Cointreau said the second half of its 1996/97 fiscal year began with a satisfying level of activity which should support the improvement in the pre-tax, pre-exceptional result.

"As in each year, the second semester is determining for the full-year results. The start of the second half has registered a satisfying level of activity which should support the improvement in the pre-tax, pre-exceptional result already seen," the company said in its earnings statement for the 1996/97 first half ending on September 30.
The pre-tax, pre-exceptional loss for the 1996/97 first half narrowed to one million francs from a prior-year loss of 39 million francs.
